prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a very clear high-resolution landscape game design comparison board for a NIKKE-inspired top-down arena action game. Purpose: explain TWO DIFFERENT proposals, not an approved design. Real polished illustrated UI screenshots with big readable text, not abstract boxes full of prose. Dark navy sci-fi interface, ivory text, cyan permanent upgrade accents, amber temporary upgrade accents, restrained anime illustration of Snow White (white-haired woman in white hood and combat gear carrying a large rifle) and robotic turrets. Generous spacing, large type, few labels. Overall title "TALENT TREES: TWO POSSIBLE DIRECTIONS". Subtitle "Design comparison — not implemented". Layout: two horizontal rows, each with 3 large panels joined by clear arrows. Column headings "BEFORE THE ROUND", "DURING THE ROUND", "AFTER THE ROUND".
TOP ROW label "A — MY PREVIOUS PROPOSAL". Left panel a small talent tree with three unlocked nodes depicting spare turret, flaming missile, reloading turret. Labels "Tree unlocks your upgrade pool" and "Start with basic abilities". Middle panel a LEVEL UP choice UI with three illustrated cards "Extra Turret", "Burning Missiles", "Auto Reload". Burning Missiles selected with amber highlight. Small top-down combat vignette below showing Snow White and a turret firing burning missiles. Label "Choose existing talents during play". Right panel two clearly separate lines with matching icons: "KEEP: talent unlocks" cyan and "RESET: selected talent effects" amber. Show burning missile card faded and base turret remaining. Bottom short row caption "Unlocked does not mean active at the start."
BOTTOM ROW label "B — KEEP YOUR CURRENT TALENTS". Left panel bright purchased talent nodes linked to a ready combat loadout, showing a permanent flaming turret ability. Labels "Purchased talents start active" and "Your build stays yours". Middle panel LEVEL UP choice UI with NEW temporary additions "Ricochet", "Orbiting Drones", "Shockwave". Ricochet selected with amber highlight. Combat vignette showing same flaming turret now with a missile bouncing between two robots. Label "Add new temporary upgrades". Right panel two clearly separate lines: "KEEP: your full talent build" cyan and "RESET: temporary additions" amber. Show flaming turret retained, ricochet card faded. Bottom short row caption "Permanent talents + a different extra layer each round."
Footer "Illustrative upgrade examples. Neither option is a direct copy of HoloCure or Hades."
Make the key distinction visually unmistakable: A re-earns existing talent effects each round, B keeps those effects and adds a separate temporary layer. No currency costs, no percentages, no extra menus, no illegible microtext. Do not label either option recommended or implemented. All text concise and spelled correctly. Full image itself should explain the contrast.
